mapper.sql: d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},d.name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},d.code)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},d.ip_address)>0OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sop_device_connection filter_c WHERE filter_c.device_id=d.id AND filter_c.deleted_at IS NULL AND LOCATE(#{keyword},filter_c.host)>0))AND d.status=#{status}
mapper.select: SELECT d.* ,l.name AS location_name ,m.name AS model_name,s.name AS station_name,c.transport,c.protocol,c.host AS connection_host,c.port AS connection_port,c.path AS connection_path,c.host_key,c.device_key,c.enabled AS connection_enabled FROM d LEFT JOIN sop_location l ON l.id=d.location_id JOIN sop_resource_model m ON m.id=d.model_id LEFT JOIN sop_station s ON s.id=d.station_id LEFT JOIN sop_device_connection c ON c.device_id=d.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT d.* ,l.name AS location_name FROM d LEFT JOIN sop_location l ON l.id=d.location_id WHERE d.id=#{id} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
